name: Outline development
description: Start the local Redis/Postgres containers and the Outline dev server, install dependencies, and run the checks from AGENTS.md and the README.

actions.title: Redis + Postgres
actions.description: Runs the redis and postgres Compose services in the foreground (ports 6379 and 5432 on 127.0.0.1), as `make up` needs. Stopping stops the containers; data is kept.

actions.title: Install dependencies
actions.description: Runs `yarn install --immutable` (Yarn 4 via Corepack). Needed once before the dev server or checks work.

actions.title: Install local SSL cert
actions.description: Runs `yarn install-local-ssl` so https://local.outline.dev:3000 (the URL in .env.development) works. Part of `make up`.

actions.title: Migrate dev database
actions.description: Runs `yarn db:migrate` against DATABASE_URL (dev defaults in .env.development). Needs the services action running.

actions.title: Dev server (backend + Vite)
actions.description: Runs `yarn dev:watch`: the backend with nodemon rebuilds (all services) plus the Vite frontend. Needs dependencies installed and the services action running.

actions.title: Lint (oxlint)
actions.description: Runs `yarn lint` (type-aware oxlint over app, server, shared, plugins).

actions.title: Format check (oxfmt)
actions.description: Runs `yarn format:check`; reports formatting problems without changing files.

actions.title: Type check (tsc)
actions.description: Runs `yarn tsc` for the whole repository. Large check: run one at a time.

actions.title: Test one file
actions.description: Runs `yarn test PATH` (Vitest, TZ=UTC) for one test file, the preferred way in AGENTS.md. Server tests need the test database (see test-db-prepare).

path.description: Test file path relative to the repository root, e.g. shared/utils/date.test.ts. Plain file path only: letters, digits, and . _ / @ -; must not start with -.

actions.title: Recreate test database
actions.description: DROPS and recreates the test database, then migrates it (NODE_ENV=test sequelize db:drop, db:create, db:migrate), as `make test` does. Only touches the test database from .env.test. Needs the services action running.

argv: set -e; yarn sequelize db:drop; yarn sequelize db:create; yarn sequelize db:migrate
